pages.useful_because: The homepage shows a Rio Rancho or Albuquerque customer what Goff Electric actually does and how to reach it at any hour: eight of the ten services with a real job photo each (commercial electrical rooms, panel terminations, atrium pendants, a living-room fan, trench and conduit work), the 4.9 Google rating from 42 reviews with the live review feed, the six towns served across Sandoval and Bernalillo counties, why the high desert matters for electrical work (monsoon lightning and surges, summer cooling loads, load calculations before an EV charger circuit), the warning signs that call for an emergency visit, and plain answers to permit, panel-capacity, surge and licensing questions. Sibling pages go deeper on one service or town; this page is the only one that lays out the whole service mix, the four-step job flow and the 24/7 line together.
